content: Angela Nissel’s latest book, Good Grief, Pass the Bread, Mom Is Dead, is my kind of memoir. Sure, it’s a deeply emotional tale about caring for a terminally ill parent. But it’s delivered with the sort of gallows humor that I often turn to to get me through tough times.  Of course, that sort of dark humor should come as no surprise from Nissel. She first made a splash with The Broke Diaries, which grew out of a blog she kept in college detailing her daily struggles and, at times, embarrassment at being a broke student. Eventually she went on to produce and write for hit shows including Scrubs and The Boondocks. One of her most lasting contributions is undeniably Okayplayer, which she co-founded with Questlove. Though, as we’ll find out shortly, being involved with one of the most important online outlets in hip hop is something of a bittersweet memory for Nissel. Oh, and she has my favorite GIF submission yet. What is your most indispensable tool? A knockoff Swiss Army Knife. It was a gift from the Scrubs grips over 20 years ago. I always have a screwdriver, a knife, and a corkscrew in my pocket. I feel like a badass. Which is the most underappreciated? My dog. He’s analog and breaks down my cardboard boxes in seconds. Now they all fit in the recycle bin. What is the first app you install on a new phone or computer? (Do not count preinstalled software like Gmail.) Craigslist. Youngins sleep on Craigslist. I’ve found a free patio set and in the early aughts when I was lonely and new in L.A. I made a friend to go clubbing with. I forgot my wallet, and she thought I was scamming her and we never hung out again, but I still love Craigslist.  What is one thing you wish you could change about your phone? That I somehow still butt dial people. The phone biometrically knows my face, but can’t tell when it’s my wallet accidentally dialing someone? What sites do you have pinned to your tab bar? Wordle. Connections. Essays I swear I’m going to get around to reading but never do. Now I feel badly. I’m going to read one. How many tabs do you have open right now? I limited myself to four or my anxiety starts skyrocketing.  Which social media platform do you use the most (if any)? Instagram, because I’ve been told by my book publisher that in 2026 I have to make “charismatic vertical videos” to sell my latest book. I’m working on being both vertical and charismatic. What is your happy place online? A small corner of Reddit where we laugh at the shenanigans of one celebrity wife. I love that place so much I even thanked our group by nickname in my latest book’s acknowledgments.  What is your favorite gadget you’ve ever owned? My first Fitbit. For a person who grew up on Commodore 64s that took an hour to load video games, wearable tech that instantly tells you how lazy you are seemed like something out of The Jetsons. Now robots are performing surgeries, and the goalpost for futuristic tech has moved. Which was the most disappointing? Wearable tech that was supposed to shock me into breaking bad habits. I was like, “Why am I doing this to myself?” What game do you have the fondest memories of? Castle Wolfenstein! The mechanics of that game on the Commodore 64 blew me away! Of course, now, it looks like Pong compared to newer games, but when I played it with my brother, I remember feeling like I was in the future, yet killing Nazis from the past. What is one thing you wish you had created? I wish I’d created The Blackening. It’s a movie. It’s so brilliant that I’m unsure how they got it made. A lot of brilliance tends to die in development out here in Hollywood to make way for “sure money bet” reboots. What creation are you most proud of? The groundbreaking site I created with Questlove. Which are you least proud of? The groundbreaking site I created with Questlove. For 25 years, I’ve had to answer questions about why the only woman involved isn’t mentioned in the creation of the website, why the man I hired suddenly replaced me, or why I don’t know who owns the site. I’ve also learned of how many women — mostly of color — have been erased from their creations as the Internet moved from “cool place to hang” to corporate megamall. I’m proud of my part in Internet hip-hop history, but I hate how many women I meet who have been erased.  What’s the best piece of advice you’ve ever received? Be interesting and interested! That means get offline and have things to talk about besides what social media is talking about. Despite us being so connected, we have a loneliness problem in the US. Getting offline, taking local community college classes, and free birdwatching groups has taught me so much and given me new acquaintances, both bird and human. What do you do when you need to focus? Take an edible. I’m an experienced user now. They used to make me paranoid, but now I’m like an edibles master, and I know just the right dose to take so my anxiety disappears, and I can relax into making some art without the voice in my head that says “This sucks! Everyone is going to hate this, and you’ll die broke!” What do you do when you’re feeling stuck? Give myself permission to relax and take in someone else’s creation. Permission to be stuck and get inspiration from someone else’s book / movie / Substack has been a big help for me. There’s so much amazing art around, and when I look at other people’s, it reminds me why I feel the drive to create. When was the last time you went somewhere without your phone? Every day I go to the dog park without it. I feel we can learn so much from just watching nature, including our beloved mutts. I feel we stole the game of American football from how dogs play. My dog is always defense, btw. What’s the last piece of physical media you bought? Books! Last book purchase was If I Ruled the World by Amy Dubois Barnett. What do you think is worth splurging on? chineseSummary: 安吉拉·尼塞尔的最新著作《好悲伤、传递面包、妈妈死了》是我的回忆录。当然，这是一个关于照顾身患绝症父母的深刻情感故事。但它以一种残酷的幽默来表达，我经常用这种幽默来帮助我度过困难时期。当然，那种[…]
chineseContent: 安吉拉·尼塞尔的最新著作《好悲伤、传递面包、妈妈死了》是我的回忆录。当然，这是一个关于照顾身患绝症父母的深刻情感故事。但它是用一种绞刑架式的幽默来表达的，我经常用这种幽默来帮助我度过困难时期。  当然，尼塞尔的这种黑色幽默并不令人意外。她首先因《破产日记》而引起轰动，该日记源于她在大学时保留的一个博客，详细描述了她每天的挣扎，有时还记录了作为一名破产学生的尴尬。最终，她继续为《实习医生风云》和《The Boondocks》等热门节目制作和编剧。无可否认，她最持久的贡献之一是她与 Questlove 共同创立的 Okplayer。不过，正如我们很快就会发现的那样，参与嘻哈界最重要的在线媒体之一对尼塞尔来说是一段苦乐参半的回忆。哦，她还提交了我最喜欢的 GIF 动图。你最不可或缺的工具是什么？仿制瑞士军刀。这是 20 多年前 Scrubs 握把的礼物。我的口袋里总是有一把螺丝刀、一把刀和一个开瓶器。我觉得自己像个坏蛋。哪个最被低估？我的狗。他是模拟的，可以在几秒钟内分解我的纸板箱。现在它们都可以放入回收站。您在新手机或电脑上安装的第一个应用程序是什么？ （不计算 Gmail 等预装软件。） Craigslist。 Youngins 睡在 Craigslist 上。我找到了一套免费的露台，刚到洛杉矶时，当我感到孤独和陌生时，我交了一个朋友一起去泡吧。我忘记带钱包了，她以为我在骗她，我们再也没有出去玩过，但我仍然喜欢 Craigslist。  您希望可以改变手机的哪一件事？我不知何故仍然打屁股打电话给别人。电话生物识别
